decisive_items: a well-demarcated, relatively homogeneous mass filling the fourth ventricle
response.rationale: Adult fourth ventricle mass with homogeneous non-enhancing features favors ependymoma over medulloblastoma (typically pediatric, enhancing) and cerebellar astrocytoma (usually hemispheric, cystic).

rejected.why: Cerebellar astrocytoma typically arises in cerebellar hemisphere, not centered in fourth ventricle; imaging lacks cystic/nodular pattern.
Medulloblastoma is more common in children and usually enhances; adult presentation with non-enhancing homogeneous mass is less typical.
